The *Mahantaraduka* (Patthana 20.5) is a text of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka located within the *Paṭṭhāna*. In the Abhidhamma matrix (*mātikā*), the *mahantaraduka* represents the "longer intermediate set of fourteen dyads," an established category of factors wherein numerous couplets analyze the mutual relationships between consciousness and mental states [Potter 1996]. Within the combinatorial system of the *Paṭṭhāna*, this section treats the conditional relations structuring these fourteen dyads [Potter 1996]. The secondary literature in the dossier does not study Patthana 20.5 directly, referring to the *mahantaraduka* primarily in the context of the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī* and *Dhātukathā* matrices [Potter 1996].
